texte.L’approche retenue COMMANDE la charge de: The approach chosen GOVERNS the burden of proof

The approach chosen GOVERNS the burden of proof: a harmonised standard or a common specification open a presumption and are documented; « another standard » and « another technical solution » additionally call for what is not covered, the justification and the objective evidence.
texte.L’article # du règlement (UE) #/# impose: Article # of Regulation (EU) #/# requires the provider of a high-risk AI system to have a quality management system. prEN # says how to build it, and only one of its parts has no counterpart in either ISO # or ISO/IEC #: the regulatory compliance strategy of §#. This path sets that out first, because it is what caps everything else.
